headline: Nasdaq Futures Drop Over 1% as Alphabet Tumbles 10% After Revenue Miss
summary: Nasdaq futures fell more than 1% after Alphabet shares sank 10% in extended trading due to revenue falling short of market expectations, denting sentiment in artificial intelligence.
why: Alphabet is one of the world's largest tech companies, whose financial performance heavily influences broad tech equity indexes and AI valuations.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: Shares dropped 10% after quarterly sales missed analysts' expectations.

impacts.name: Nasdaq Futures
impacts.why: Alphabet's post-earnings decline dragged down major US technology indices.

why_moved: A 10% after-hours plunge in Alphabet shares triggered broader selling across technology futures and AI-exposed names.
